## Frodo CLI version
Provide output of `frodo -v`

## Describe the issue
A clear and concise description of what the issue is.

## Stack trace (if the command crashed)
The npm package prints stack traces without the original TypeScript file names. If you can, run the failing command again with `FRODO_SOURCE_MAPS=1` in the environment and paste the trace from that run.
